purpose: Is an unlisted shell command denied automatically, with no approval surface in a non-interactive session? The evidence is P15a's retained output; this record extracts it rather than paying for a second session.

python3 -c '

d = json.load(open('"'"'docs/research/bounded-discovery-qualification-2026-09-12/probes/P15a-restricted-with-tools-bash/result.json'"'"'))
